state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors present Constitutional AI as a method that trains a non-evasive, relatively harmless assistant without any human feedback labels for harms, and say it therefore improves upon and partially replaces reinforcement learning from human feedback (Christiano et al., 2017). They report that the resulting RL-CAI assistant is preferred by crowdworkers over models trained with previously collected human harmlessness labels.
title: Bai et al.'s Constitutional AI improves on and partly replaces Christiano et al.'s RLHF
